name: Sika deer
description: Often in small herds or family groups.

name: Beaver
description: Live in family units, but often seen alone swimming.

name: Rabbit
description: Live in large warrens; often graze in groups.

name: Mountain hare
description: Solitary; unlike rabbits, they do not dig warrens.

name: House mouse
description: Social; live in family groups near humans.

name: Grey squirrel
description: Solitary, though can be seen feeding near others.

name: Red deer
description: Highly social; live in herds (sexes often separate).

name: European badger
description: Live in social clans, but often forage alone.

name: Daubenton's bat
description: Roost in colonies; feed in groups over water.

name: Common pipistrelle
description: Roost in colonies; hunt in loose groups.

name: Marsh frog
description: Can form large choruses in breeding season.

name: Common frog
description: Gather in large numbers to spawn.

name: Common toad
description: Migrate and breed in large groups.
